title: Front Cover
content: The spiky sea cucumber (Stichopus chloronotus) in a seagrass meadow on the coast of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India. This cover image relates to Short Communication “Ocean acidification research on ecologically and economically important sea cucumbers is limited globally” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70128], by Job & Mishra. Photo credit: Amrit Kumar Mishra.
